nachhilfeangebot.title: My tutoring offer
nachhilfeangebot.body:
Do you need help in Maths, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering for your studies? Or in French or English for school? Then I can surely help you as a Maths and Computer Science master, with my teaching degree in physics, with my 1-year professional experience as a software developer and as a long-standing tutor of many math lectures at the LMU in Munich.

It doesn't matter whether you study Maths, Physics or Computer Science as a major or minor subject and whether you need help with proves or arithmetic problems. As soon as you have emailed me enough tasks for a tutoring session to imelflorianingerl{'@'}gmail.com, we can make an appointment.

Although I am actually a STEM tutor, I am also enthusiastic about languages, contact and literature and often give STEM tutoring to French people, Canadians, Americans and English people. That is why I can also support you well in the foreign languages French and English.

For further information about possible topics, making appointments, technology used for the tutoring sessions, prices and cancellation policy, please scroll down!

matheuni.title: Mathematics
matheuni.imageAlt: Illustration of mathematics: a convex example
matheuni.body:
You are good at calculating, but you can't prove anything? In a private lesson, we can do both.

Here is a list of topics I am familiar with: Linear Algebra 1+2 (1,2, 3 , 4), Analysis 1 (1,2, 3, 4), Analysis 2 (1,2, 3, 4, 5), Analysis 3 (1, 2, 3, 4), Numeric 1+2 (1, 2, 3, 4), Stochastics (1, 2, 3, 4, 5), Complex Analysis 1+2 (1, 2 ), Ordinary Differential Equations (1, 2, 3, 4, 5), Partial Differential Equations (1, 2 ), Probability Theory (1, 2, 3), Functional Analysis 1+2, Algebra (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), Algebraic Number Theory (1), Higher Algebra, Logic (1, 2, 3, 4), Optimisation (1,2), Stochastic Processes (1,2,3), Statistics (1, 2, 3, 4), Graph Theory (1), Computer-assisted Mathematics (with R, Python, Matlab), Geometry and Topology of Surfaces (1)

infouni.title: Computer science
infouni.body:
Have you got problems with the grammar of theoretical computer science? Then I can help you!

Here is a list of the topics with examples of private lessons that I am familiar with: Formal Languages and Complexity (1,2 , 3, 4, 5), Introduction to Theoretical Computer Science (1, 2, 3, 4, 5), Algorithms and Data Structures (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), Computational Complexity Theory ( 1), Introduction to programming (1,2, 3), Functional programming with Haskell (1, 2, 3), Web technologies, Database systems (1, 2, 3, 4), Information Theory (1, 2, 3, 4), Theory of Programming (1,2), Computer Architecture(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), Distributed Systems, Discrete Structures (1, 2, 3, 4), Logic for Computer Scientists (1), Intelligent Systems (with Prolog) (1), Computer graphics (1, 2), Reactive Systems (1, 2, 3), Data Analysis and Visualisation in R (1,2,3)
infouni.body2: I can also help you well with programming (Java, C#, C/C++, Haskell, Python, Rust, Prolog, OCaml, R) and web programming (Html, CSS, JavaScript,PHP,MySQL, NodeJS, VueJS, TypeScript, AngularJS, MongoDB ). For that, we would use Eclipse, IntelliJ or Visual Studio (Code) as the IDE together with the CodeTogether-plugin, which enables pair programming.

preise.title: Prices, appointments and payment
preise.body:
Prices

4*30 for a 4*60min learning package

35 euros for a 60min individual lesson

All-or-nothing package: 500 euros for a passed exam / 0 euros otherwise

4*20 euros for a 4*60min learning package in French, English, German, Spanish or Italian

30 euros for a 60min individual lesson in languages

If the tutoring session lasted longer than 60 min, the following formula applies:
Price = Duration / (60 min) * (Price for 60 min)

If the tutoring session was shorter than 60 min (e.g. because you had no time or no more exercises), it still costs as much as for 60 min

4-hour learning package

You can get the discounted price for a 4*60 min learning package if you have enough great exercises for at least one hour per week. I am available every day of the week from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. and I can help you in a great many subjects. !!! Caution !!! If for any reason you can't make it in a week or have no need, the money would still be due. Otherwise, the same cancellation conditions as below apply to each of the 4 appointments of a package.

All-or-nothing package

With the all-or-nothing package, we prepare together for an exam on a specific date. If you pass this exam, we will all be happy. If you don't pass it, you only get your money back if you can send me the pictures of your failed exam from the exam inspection.

Making appointments, payment and cancellation conditions

I only make a first appointment via email, further ones also via Skype. I work Monday to Sunday from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. The process of making an appointment is as follows:

  1. You send me your exercises and your associated theory script
  2. If I am familiar with exercises like these, I will let you know and you can transfer the money in advance (via Paypal with the "Send money to friends" option* or by bank transfer and screenshot). In the subject line, please also include your name and your appointment preferences, for example something like "Math tutoring Elif desired on Wed 11.1 from 3 p.m. to 9 p.m. or Sat 12.1 between 8 a.m. and 12 p.m. or Saturday and Sunday the whole day"
  3. After I receive the advance payment, I will give you a confirmation of the appointment according to your preferences (if it suits me) or I will make 2-3 appointment suggestions for the next few days myself
  4. We are looking forward to our appointment and you may send any missing or additional exercises/scripts or ask me for good learning material.

!!! Attention cancellation conditions , No rescheduling !!! In the case of a cancellation (at any time beforehand), technical problems (e.g. unstable internet for more than 10 min or the inability to use Skype or Zoom) or a delay of more than 10 minutes on your part, the fee is due and there is no further waiting time on my part - regardless of the duration of the booked appointment.

In the event of short-term cancellations or a technical failure on my part, you will receive a prompt replacement appointment or your money back.

*Without the "Send money to a friend" option, there is a 2 euro fee for Paypal.

unterrichtsmethode.title: Teaching method
unterrichtsmethode.body:
From the exercises that you send me, we choose the best ones. For explanations I use sketches, words, general rules and theorems (from your script), colors, formulas, examples and in the end, the task will explain itself through its solution and its interpretation in the factual context and its validation.

In tutoring, an open relationship at eye level and in the flow is important to me, where we learn as much as possible to pass your exams with ease. To make this possible, I know the terms and definitions that appear in the exercise statements (or maybe you do) or I can look them up quickly. Tutoring becomes exciting with many of our own, creative and present thoughts and when none of us has thought more about the exercises as preparation than the rough solution approaches.

After a tutoring session, we each reflect on and store for ourselves what we have learned and what we could have done better. With enough motivation, need and suitable exercises, we can arrange a new appointment quite promptly.

tutorium.title: Tutorial/Group lessons
tutorium.body:
In the tutorial group, you also get individual support for your exercises, because at most 5 pupils are present. If you only need occasional starting points/ideas/hints for your exercises, can work with them and would like to benefit from the learning energy of a group, this is ideal for you.

For the time being, the tutorial group always takes place on Saturdays from 18:45 - 19:45.

You will receive a Miro whiteboard link and an invitation link to a Teams meeting by email from me if you have registered in advance.

The other participants in the tutorial group also study Maths, Computer Science, Physics or Engineering. As soon as you get stuck on one of your exercises, you press the Hey button on the Miro whiteboard and get help.

online.title: Online-Tutoring
online.body: For the online tutoring, I use Skype or Zoom. If you have preferences, you can mention them. In addition, I use the Miro-Online-Whiteboard, which we can use to collaborate. A full whiteboard would look like this: Example-Whiteboard

praesenz.title: In-person tutoring
praesenz.body:
In-person tutoring takes place in my office at Walchenseestraße 6 in Gröbenzell without any restrictions. When the weather is nice, we can also go outside. You are very welcome as long as you bring enough great exercises.

If you are an elementary or middle school pupil and are not yet mobile and need in-person tutoring, I am happy to come to your home for an extra charge.

uebermich.title: About me
uebermich.list:
• Mathematics and Computer Science Master at the LMU in Munich with top marks
  • 1st State Examination for teaching Physics and Mathematics in High School
  • >5 years tutor of many Mathematics and Physics lectures at the LMU in Munich
  • High School diploma in English, French and German at the Gymnasium Puchheim (skipped two grades)
  • 1/2 year teacher at the High School of Gröbenzell and Olching for Mathematics and Physics
  • Since October 2020 private, independent full-time tutor for German-, French- and English-speaking students
  • 1 year professional experience as a software developer
  • Yoga teacher training at Sivananda Yoga 2018
  • Reiki Master training 2024
  • committed, ambitious and sociable
uebermich.body2:
I was born in 1993 as the son of an electrical engineer and a nutritionist. I was also deeply influenced by my grandfather, who partially lived on home-grown vegetables and partially on dandelions in order to be able to pass on more money to his grandchildren for their studies.
I also learned a lot from my aunt and my uncle, who - because they were history and language teachers - always knew how to tell plenty of entertaining things.
I myself am interested in everything that has to do with mathematics, natural science, technology, language, nutrition and relationships, the latter very much to the delight of my relationship trainer and my English, French and Spanish tutors, who earn a fortune from me.
With all that is intellectually possible to learn, I myself do a lot of yoga, sport and forest walks as a balance and I also recommend that to you as preparation for an exam.
